caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical stoneware jar with a narrow mouth and a slightly flared rim. The jar is predominantly a grayish-tan color with subtle shading to indicate its rounded form and texture. Around the upper section of the jar, there is a decorative blue band featuring an alternating pattern of curved and pointed elements resembling draped fabric or a scalloped design. The surface of the jar displays some irregularities, including scratches, stains, and cracks, which are rendered in brown and dark lines. On the central part of the jar, the text "COMMERAW'S STONEWARE" is inscribed in blue uppercase letters, slightly angled. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
